Chapter 8: Becoming an Advocate—Turning Pain into Purpose
As the wounds of the past start to heal, something new and unexpected begins to grow—a sense of purpose.
The woman who once felt completely powerless now finds herself drawn to advocacy. Why? Because she knows, deep down, what silence costs, and how much courage it takes to finally break free.
She wants others to find their own path to freedom, just like she did.
It doesn’t start with grand gestures. It’s the small things—volunteering at a local shelter, speaking up at a support group, or simply writing about what she’s been through.
Each time she shares her story, that old fear of being judged gets a little smaller. She’s surprised to discover that her voice, once so tightly held in, actually has the power to inspire and lift others up.
But advocacy isn’t easy. There are days when the work feels endless, and progress seems painfully slow.
The systems that should protect survivors? They’re often stretched thin, underfunded, and overwhelmed. But she doesn’t give up. She knows change is possible, even if it happens one life at a time.
Along the way, she meets others who’ve escaped similar pain—women and men from every walk of life, all united by the drive for justice and healing.
Together, they organize workshops, push for new laws, and create spaces where people still trapped in abuse can finally feel safe.
The work? It’s tough. But it’s also deeply rewarding.
Most people have no idea just how much bravery it takes to speak out. She faces criticism from those who defend the FLDS, and skepticism from outsiders who just can’t understand what life is really like inside a closed community.
Still, she stands her ground—driven by the simple belief that everyone deserves freedom and dignity.
Through advocacy, she discovers a meaning that had always been out of reach. She’s no longer defined by what happened to her, but by her commitment to creating a better future—for herself, for other survivors, and for anyone still searching for a way out.
The journey from victim to advocate isn’t smooth or straightforward. There are setbacks, and yes, plenty of moments of doubt.
But with each step, she reclaims her power and her voice, slowly becoming a beacon of hope—a living example that healing and transformation really are possible.
